title: PCR Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Plate samples in specified wells
steps.instruction: Distribute the reagents across the plate for up to 384 samples as follows: place NTC with PCR mastermix into wells P17‑19, add cDNA IPC template into wells P20‑22, and add NTC with IPC mastermix into wells P23‑24.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the required .json labware files (if any) to upload your custom labware.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file (a .py script) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map, placing all labware, tip racks, and modules in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips if needed.
